message.title: Tom Vidar Rygh recommended as new Chair of the Board of Directors of Xplora Technologies AS
message.body:
Xplora's Nomination Committee has recommended Tom Vidar Rygh as new Chair of
the Board of Directors of Xplora Technologies AS (Xplora).

Mr. Rygh has extensive experience in the telecommunications and technology
sectors, having served as Chair of Telenor ASA and as a board member of NetCom
ASA and Telia Overseas AB. He also brings broad strategic, financial and
governance expertise from leading Norwegian and international companies,
including Oslo Børs, Carlsberg Breweries A/S and Storebrand ASA. For more than
a decade, he served as Chair of Europris ASA, where he played an active role
incompany's development as a listed company.

The Nomination Committee considers Mr. Rygh's background particularly relevant
to Xplora as the Company enters its next phase of development. His experience
provides valuable exposure to the telecommunications and technology sectors.
Mr. Rygh indirectly owns 100,000 shares in Xplora through a wholly owned
investment company. The Nomination Committee has also considered Mr. Rygh's
independence and concludes that he meets the applicable independence
requirements to serve as Chair of the Board.

The current Chair of the Board, Tore Engebretsen, will step down as Chair,
after seven years in the position in which Xplora has experienced a remarkable
expansion, growth and development.

"Working with Sten and XPLORA is a true pleasure. However, I will be 75 this
autumn. There is a time for everything," states Engebretsen.

The election of the new Chair of the Board, as well as the resignation of the
current Chair, will take place at an Extraordinary General Meeting in October,
which will be convened shortly.

For more information, please contact:
Thomas Raaschou, Chair Nomination Committee, +47 48404242, tr@nomacapital.no
Sten Kirkbak, CEO, +47 92203710, sten.kirkbak@xplora.com
Knut Stålen, CFO, +47 92043458, knut.stalen@xplora.com

About Xplora Technologies AS Xplora Technologies is a Norway-founded,
technology company creating smart devices, services and communication
solutions for children, youth and seniors that keep families connected, safe,
and balanced. The company's purpose is to build a safer and healthier digital
life for all generations. As the pioneer of the kids' smartwatch category in
Europe, Xplora Technologies today serves the full spectrum of family needs
from early childhood to later life, through its two brands Xplora and Doro.
